Personal Large Ground Drone (Its sheer size takes up a 10x10m/yds [5x5 Squares] area centered on itself). A 10×10m construction drone, 100m from your Neuroport (or an access point you're into), 48 hours a charge from a big power source. Treads (no Aimed Shots against it); while it has HP it's Thick Steel cover with that much HP. LL/IR/UV camera and one tool: a crane arm (lifts 50 tons; 2 MOVE while loaded), a dozer blade (shoves up a 6×2m line of cover; the GM sets its type and HP), or a rock crusher (Excellent ROF1 melee, 5d6). Modes: Standby, Direct Control, Auto (keeps doing its last job and won't stop for anything, people included, unless it would destroy itself).

Cost: 10,000eb
MOVE: 3
HP: 70
CN: 10
Counter: DV17 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter
